title: Console Rollouts GA Launch Checklist — Route-level Experiments (A/B testing)
content:
Owner: Connor O’Brien (Release coordination)
Last updated: 2025-04-08
Target train: Console 2025.04 (GA enablement staged; see Rollout Plan)
Scope: Route-level experiments (A/B/n) in Console Rollouts: control plane + router assignment + telemetry attribution + dashboards/alerts + RBAC/audit + docs.
Non-goals for GA: full stat-sig engine; customer-defined custom metrics ingestion.

How to use this doc
- This is the “go/no-go” checklist for GA. Items must be checked off OR explicitly deferred w/ documented risk + mitigation + exec sign-off.
- Owners listed are accountable for the checkbox.
- GA criteria are at the bottom. If any “Blocker” item is not complete, GA defaults do not flip.

Legend
[BLOCKER] Must be complete to flip GA defaults / remove beta gate.
[REQUIRED] Must be complete to allow GA rollout to begin (flagged rollout ok).
[RECOMMENDED] Prefer before GA; can follow with risk acceptance.


1) Release readiness — feature flags & rollout controls
1.1 Feature flags defined + documented
- [x] [BLOCKER] Feature flag exists for route experiments global gate (route_experiments_enabled)
  Owner: Connor O’Brien / Dylan Brooks
  Notes: Landed in redwood/pr-28673.
- [x] [REQUIRED] Per-account allowlist support (beta/early GA)
  Owner: Chloe Martin
- [x] [REQUIRED] Per-region rollout knob (region allowlist or policy-gated enablement)
  Owner: Ethan Park / Jordan Lee
- [x] [BLOCKER] Kill switch for auto-stop / hard-stop guardrails (guardrails_hard_stop_enabled)
  Owner: Rafael Mendes / Sean Gallagher
  Notes: See discussions; we allow soft-stop by default; hard-stop must remain opt-in with kill switch.

1.2 Default behaviors confirmed (GA defaults)
- [x] [BLOCKER] Default guardrails: latency/error/cost thresholds chosen and documented
  Owner: Marissa Cole / Sean Gallagher
  Notes: Must match Console copy and alert thresholds. Avoid false positive auto-stop.
- [x] [BLOCKER] Default stop semantics confirmed (soft-stop default; hard-stop opt-in)
  Owner: Marissa Cole / Dylan Brooks
- [x] [REQUIRED] Limits enforced: max variants, min split, allowed stickiness keys
  Owner: Jada Williams / Jordan Lee
- [x] [REQUIRED] Overlapping experiment policy finalized + enforced (block vs priority)
  Owner: Jada Williams

1.3 Rollback strategy documented and tested
- [x] [BLOCKER] “Disable experiments” rollback path validated (flag off + router safe defaults)
  Owner: Vikram Singh / Jordan Lee
- [x] [REQUIRED] Console UI handles flag-off gracefully (no broken pages; clear messaging)
  Owner: Dylan Brooks / Felix Schneider
- [x] [RECOMMENDED] Runbook includes decision tree: when to flip flag vs stop specific experiment
  Owner: Rafael Mendes


2) Data plane + assignment correctness
2.1 Deterministic bucketing correctness
- [x] [BLOCKER] Deterministic assignment stable across restarts + regions (within stated constraints)
  Owner: Jordan Lee
  Evidence: Unit + integration tests; see redwood/pr-28610.
- [x] [BLOCKER] Stickiness key precedence: documented + matches implementation (SDK + headers)
  Owner: Jordan Lee / DevEx follow-up
- [x] [BLOCKER] Missing stickiness key behavior: avoids low-entropy defaults; skew fix landed
  Owner: Jordan Lee
  Evidence: redwood/pr-28705.

2.2 Routing precedence with rollouts/fallback policies
- [x] [BLOCKER] Experiment applied before fallback selection per final precedence decision
  Owner: Mina Haddad / Elena Popov
  Evidence: redwood/pr-28457.
- [x] [REQUIRED] Canary + experiment interaction: documented “what wins” & validated
  Owner: Hannah Rivera / Jada Williams

2.3 Debugging hooks
- [x] [REQUIRED] Internal assignment debug endpoint gated + redacted
  Owner: Jordan Lee / Marcus Lin
  Evidence: redwood/pr-28596 (confirm RBAC restrictions).
- [x] [RECOMMENDED] Support-friendly “variant header” troubleshooting steps included in docs
  Owner: DevEx (Dylan to route)


3) Telemetry + metrics attribution (request/token)
3.1 Schema & propagation
- [x] [BLOCKER] experiment_id + variant_id present in request context for all paths (including streaming)
  Owner: Caleb Johnson / Vikram Singh
  Evidence: redwood/pr-28470 + fix redwood/pr-28622.
- [x] [BLOCKER] OTel span tagging conventions finalized + implemented
  Owner: Logan Wright / Allison Grant
  Evidence: redwood/pr-28489.
- [x] [BLOCKER] Cardinality controls in place (tag restrictions + sampling strategy)
  Owner: Logan Wright / Allison Grant
  Evidence: redwood/pr-28741.

3.2 Aggregation & freshness
- [x] [BLOCKER] Rollup tables/datasets live for per-variant latency/cost/error
  Owner: Mei Lin / Nadia Rahman
  Evidence: redwood/pr-28503.
- [x] [REQUIRED] Results API returns deltas + guardrail status; performance validated under load
  Owner: Chloe Martin / Felix Schneider
  Evidence: redwood/pr-28644.
- [ ] [REQUIRED] Data freshness SLA documented in Console (e.g., “last updated” + expected lag)
  Owner: Marissa Cole / Felix Schneider
  Due: before broader enablement beyond initial GA cohort
  Notes: Prevents “results not updating” tickets.

3.3 Backfill plan
- [x] [REQUIRED] Backfill strategy documented for schema changes; throttling plan approved
  Owner: Logan Wright / Mei Lin
- [x] [REQUIRED] Backfill is not required to flip GA defaults (explicitly accepted)
  Owner: Marissa Cole / Sean Gallagher
  Notes: Backfill may be run for beta accounts only; GA messaging must clarify limited history.


4) Console & APIs (customer-facing)
4.1 Console workflow completeness
- [x] [BLOCKER] Create experiment wizard complete: route selection, variants, splits, guardrails, confirmation
  Owner: Dylan Brooks / Kenji Nakamura
  Evidence: redwood/pr-28524.
- [x] [BLOCKER] List/details pages stable + performant (pagination, filtering)
  Owner: Felix Schneider / Chloe Martin
- [x] [BLOCKER] Results dashboard charts load within acceptable budget; cached/aggregated
  Owner: Felix Schneider
  Evidence: redwood/pr-28658.

4.2 API readiness
- [x] [BLOCKER] State machine for create/update/start/stop; idempotency expectations documented
  Owner: Chloe Martin
  Evidence: redwood/pr-28511.
- [x] [REQUIRED] API error messages are user-actionable (validation, overlap, allocations)
  Owner: Benji Okafor

4.3 UX / copy / guardrail clarity
- [x] [REQUIRED] Guardrail semantics: “soft-stop” vs “hard-stop” copy finalized
  Owner: Marissa Cole / Tessa Morgan
- [ ] [RECOMMENDED] Tooltips for variant headers and stickiness keys in Console
  Owner: Kenji Nakamura
  Notes: Support reported confusion during beta; include before announcing GA publicly.


5) Security, RBAC, audit logging, compliance
5.1 RBAC
- [x] [BLOCKER] RBAC gates for experiment mutations (create/update/start/stop/delete)
  Owner: Kaitlyn Nguyen
  Evidence: redwood/pr-28552.
- [x] [REQUIRED] Break-glass process documented (who can stop experiments in incident)
  Owner: Sean Gallagher / Marcus Lin

5.2 Audit logging
- [x] [BLOCKER] Audit events emitted for lifecycle actions (create/update/start/stop/delete)
  Owner: Kevin Osei / Marcus Lin
  Evidence: redwood/pr-28539.
- [x] [REQUIRED] Audit export includes required fields + change diff summary
  Owner: Kevin Osei
  Evidence: redwood/pr-28719.
- [x] [REQUIRED] Retention policy documented (enterprise expectations)
  Owner: Marcus Lin

5.3 Privacy / data handling
- [x] [REQUIRED] Debug endpoint redaction reviewed (no raw prompts/PII; no secret keys)
  Owner: Marcus Lin


6) Observability, dashboards, alerts, and on-call readiness
6.1 Dashboards
- [x] [BLOCKER] Standard Grafana dashboard: per-variant guardrails (p95/p99, error, cost/token)
  Owner: Allison Grant
  Evidence: observability-pack/pr-1934.
- [x] [REQUIRED] Dashboard: attribution drop rate + “variant 0 traffic” detection
  Owner: Allison Grant

6.2 Alerts
- [x] [BLOCKER] Alert rules for config propagation lag (staleness bounds) deployed
  Owner: Rafael Mendes
  Evidence: observability-pack/pr-1942.
- [x] [BLOCKER] Attribution anomalies alert (drop rate, skew) tuned to avoid noise
  Owner: Sean Gallagher / Rafael Mendes
- [x] [REQUIRED] Runbook links embedded in alert payloads and Console banners
  Owner: Rafael Mendes
  Evidence: redwood/pr-28734.

6.3 Runbooks + game day
- [x] [BLOCKER] Runbook: assignment debugging published and reviewed
  Owner: Rafael Mendes
- [x] [REQUIRED] Game day completed: propagation lag + rollback drill
  Owner: Sean Gallagher
  Notes: Capture outcomes + follow-ups in SRE channel; confirm on-call knows “stop vs flag off”.

6.4 SLOs
- [x] [REQUIRED] Control plane SLOs published (API availability; propagation staleness)
  Owner: Aisha Bello


7) Migrations, schema versioning, and deployment sequencing
7.1 Data migrations
- [x] [BLOCKER] Experiment config versioning + migrations shipped
  Owner: Michael Nguyen
  Evidence: redwood/pr-28692.
- [x] [REQUIRED] Forward/backward compatibility validated across mixed fleet during rollout
  Owner: Michael Nguyen / Vikram Singh

7.2 Deployment order (must follow)
- [x] [REQUIRED] Deploy order documented:
  1) Control plane accepts both old/new config (if applicable)
  2) Router/policy engine reads new config (with safe default)
  3) Telemetry emits new dimensions
  4) Aggregation jobs updated
  5) Console reads new APIs
  6) Flip GA flags by cohort
  Owner: Connor O’Brien

7.3 Verification steps (post-deploy)
- [x] [REQUIRED] Smoke test: create experiment -> start -> see non-zero traffic on variants
- [x] [REQUIRED] Confirm metrics attribution present on streaming + retries
- [x] [REQUIRED] Confirm propagation lag metric within bounds after config change
  Owner: Release captain (rotation)


8) Applied ML / eval-score integration (optional GA surface)
- [x] [REQUIRED] If “quality” is shown in Console, definition matches eval pipelines + docs
  Owner: Dr. Maya Srinivasan / Jonas Weber
- [x] [RECOMMENDED] Sampling rate policy documented (small traffic splits can bias)
  Owner: Selene Huang
- [ ] [RECOMMENDED] Quality regression alert banner copy and escalation path
  Owner: Selene Huang / Marissa Cole


9) Documentation, enablement, support readiness
9.1 External docs
- [x] [BLOCKER] Customer guide merged + reviewed (stickiness key guidance, headers, guardrails)
  Owner: DevEx (Dylan Brooks to drive)
  Evidence: redwood-docs/pr-1447.
- [ ] [RECOMMENDED] Troubleshooting section includes: “results lag”, “attribution missing”, “variant skew”, “overlap blocked”
  Owner: DevEx

9.2 Support + CS readiness
- [x] [REQUIRED] Internal FAQ for Support (common tickets + canned responses)
  Owner: Marissa Cole / Support lead (not listed)
- [x] [REQUIRED] Escalation routing documented: Support -> On-call -> Platform vs Console
  Owner: Sean Gallagher / Dylan Brooks

9.3 SDK notes
- [x] [REQUIRED] SDKs expose stickiness key option + variant headers surfaced
  Owner: DevEx
  Notes: Verify both TS and Python releases are cut and referenced in docs.


10) Communications plan (internal + external)
10.1 Internal announcements
- [x] [REQUIRED] #general / #eng announcement drafted (what’s launching, how to enable, where to find dashboards)
  Owner: Marissa Cole
- [x] [REQUIRED] Internal “known limitations” posted (no stat-sig; freshness expectations; cardinality constraints)
  Owner: Marissa Cole / Logan Wright

10.2 External comms (optional, timing sensitive)
- [ ] [RECOMMENDED] Public changelog / blog post queued (only after first GA cohort stable)
  Owner: Product marketing (not listed)
- [ ] [RECOMMENDED] Direct email to beta customers: GA timeline + what changes
  Owner: Customer Success (not listed)


11) Rollout plan (GA enablement)
Proposed stages (adjust based on health signals)
Stage 0: Code shipped but disabled by default (beta allowlist only)
- Entry criteria: all BLOCKER items complete.
- Exit criteria: 7 days with no Sev-1, attribution drop < threshold, propagation lag within SLO.

Stage 1: GA Early Access cohort (10–20 accounts; 1 region)
- Flip: route_experiments_enabled for allowlisted accounts in us-east only.
- Monitor: dashboards + alert noise.
- Rollback: flip cohort flag off; if systemic, flip global gate off.

Stage 2: Expand regions (us-west, eu-west)
- Add regions sequentially; 48h soak each.
- Watch: skew issues (eu-west previously flagged) and propagation lag.

Stage 3: GA default enablement
- Flip default for eligible plans/tiers.
- Keep kill switch for hard-stop guarded.


12) Go/No-Go criteria (GA gate)
GA can proceed to Stage 1 when:
- All [BLOCKER] items checked.
- SRE sign-off: Sean Gallagher confirms on-call readiness + alert tuning acceptable.
- Security sign-off: Marcus Lin confirms RBAC + audit logging requirements met.
- Telemetry sign-off: Logan Wright confirms attribution completeness + cardinality controls.
- Product sign-off: Marissa Cole confirms UX copy + limitations acceptable.

GA can proceed to Stage 3 (default enablement) when:
- Stage 1+2 completed with stable metrics for >= 7 days.
- No open Sev-2+ issues tagged “route-experiments-ga-blocker”.
- Support readiness: at least 1 week of support coverage with low confusion on variant headers and results freshness.


Open items / cut line (track explicitly)
- Freshness SLA display in Console (owner: Felix) — recommended before broad GA.
- Console tooltips re: variant headers & stickiness keys (owner: Kenji) — recommended.
- Quality regression banner copy + escalation path (owner: Selene) — recommended if quality surfaced prominently.
